description: The plot illustrates the relationship between embedding layer and average correct gate rate for different input types. The x-axis is labeled "Embedding Layer" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Average Correct Gate Rate" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. There are three lines shown: a solid blue line representing "Character Attention input" which begins at approximately 0.1 and increases to approximately 0.8 by x=5, then fluctuates between approximately 0.6 and 0.8 until x=30; a dashed red line representing "Character MLP input" which begins at approximately 0.8 and decreases to approximately 0.5 by x=5, then increases to approximately 0.7 by x=15, and declines to approximately 0.6 by x=30; and a dashed dark red line representing "Wiki MLP input" which begins at approximately 0.7 and decreases to approximately 0.4 by x=5, then increases to approximately 0.7 by x=15, and declines to approximately 0.6 by x=30. Each line is accompanied by a shaded region indicating variability around the line.
